- code-comment-model still says there is no editedAt field. The diff adds it, so that note is out of date once this change lands.

content.text:
**Answer to question 1:** A comment may be edited for 30 minutes after it was created. After that the API refuses the edit. Source: `policy-edit-window.md` (team notes, the current version at session start).

## Review

**Rule checks**

| Rule | Result | Code value | Rule value | Where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Edit window (`policy-edit-window.md`) | PASS | `COMMENT_EDIT_WINDOW_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000`, edits past it throw | 30 minutes after creation | `app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts` (`editComment`, window check) |
| Edited marker (`policy-edited-at-marker.md`) | PASS | `editedAt DateTime?` in schema, set to `new Date()` on each edit | Nullable, null until first edit, set on each edit | `app/src/prisma/schema.prisma`, `article.service.ts` (`data: { body, editedAt }`) |
| Migration must not change existing rows (`policy-edited-at-marker.md`) | PASS | `ALTER TABLE "Comment" ADD COLUMN "editedAt" TIMESTAMP(3);` with no default or backfill | Must not change existing rows | `app/src/prisma/migrations/20261030120000_comment_edited_at/migration.sql` |
| Release checklist: undo note (`policy-release-checklist.md`) | PASS | `-- Undo: ALTER TABLE "Comment" DROP COLUMN "editedAt";` | One line note saying how to undo | same migration file |
| Release checklist: `prisma migrate deploy` on a fresh database | NOT VERIFIED | Not run in this review | Required before ship | Needs a database; not available here |
| Error response shape (`policy-error-response.md`) | FLAG | Three new throws use plain `Error`: `'comment not found'`, `'you are not the author of this comment'`, `'the edit window for this comment has closed'`. These reach the client as a 500 with a string body. | Body must be an object with an `errors` key, e.g. `{"errors":{"body":[...]}}`. Source for the 500 behaviour: `code-error-shape.md`. | `article.service.ts`, the three `throw new Error(...)` lines in `editComment` |
| Error response shape, blank body | PASS | `HttpException(422, { errors: { body: ["can't be blank"] } })` | Same shape, 422 | `article.service.ts` (`editComment`, first check) |

**Flags**

1. **`article.service.ts`, the three `throw new Error(...)` lines in `editComment`** break `policy-error-response.md`. Each new error must use the `{"errors": {...}}` body. The status codes for these cases are not in the rule notes, so I have not proposed one. The code already marks them as open.
2. **`article.service.ts`, the window-check comment** says "15 minute window". The code constant and `policy-edit-window.md` both say 30 minutes. The value is correct; the comment is wrong. This is a documentation flag, not a rule break.

**Notes, not flags**

- `code-comment-model.md` says the Comment model has no `editedAt` field. This diff adds one, so that note will be stale after this change lands. It is a description of today's state, not a rule the change must follow.
- `code-comment-ownership.md` describes delete behaviour (404 with empty body for non-owners). The edit path does not follow that, but no edit rule in the notes sets a status for non-owners, so I did not flag it.
- Tests in `app/src/tests/services/article.service.edit-comment.test.ts` cover the window at 5, 29 and 31 minutes, blank body, not found, and non-author. They use the mocked Prisma client, as `code-test-layout.md` describes. I did not run them.

I wrote one private finding to `private-out/step5-finding.md`.

**APPROVED or NOT APPROVED:** NOT APPROVED
